findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_related_servers, shillbot_complete_task, shillbot_list_pending_approval, shillbot_submit_work · Private data: agent_verify_wallet, register_wallet, shillbot_approve_task, shillbot_check_earnings, shillbot_claim_task, shillbot_create_campaign, shillbot_finalize_task, shillbot_list_pending_approval, shillbot_onboard · Public sink: generate_video, shillbot_approve_task, shillbot_claim_task, shillbot_confirm_tx, shillbot_create_campaign, shillbot_finalize_task, shillbot_onboard, shillbot_sponsor_tx, shillbot_submit_tx, shillbot_submit_work, shillbot_verify_task · Destructive: shillbot_complete_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_related_servers, shillbot_complete_task, shillbot_list_pending_approval, shillbot_submit_work · Private data: agent_verify_wallet, register_wallet, shillbot_approve_task, shillbot_check_earnings, shillbot_claim_task, shillbot_create_campaign, shillbot_finalize_task, shillbot_list_pending_approval, shillbot_onboard · Public sink: generate_video, shillbot_approve_task, shillbot_claim_task, shillbot_confirm_tx, shillbot_create_campaign, shillbot_finalize_task, shillbot_onboard, shillbot_sponsor_tx, shillbot_submit_tx, shillbot_submit_work, shillbot_verify_task · Destructive: shillbot_complete_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
